Name: Rogue AI
Overview:
A machine launched into space by a dying rogue scientist. Your objective? Return to earth and slaughter the entire human race.

Also, fight suicidal space hamsters... just because...

Collect resources, upgrade buildings, and defend against overwhelming odds across two campaigns.

Features an open ended weapon upgrade system. You can choose to litter the battlefield, concentrate on a single monolithic turret, or anywhere in between.
